title: iCloud sync is terrible
body: I stopped using this app across multiple devices (just iPhone) years ago, because the sync over iCloud was complete garbage. Tried setting it up again today across devices to see if anything had improved—it’s atrocious. I purged everything from iCloud (four Streaks entries appeared there). Upon re-enabling it, I got deleted items, duplicated items, items out of sync, and it even broke the iPhone app where it now fails to even let me complete an item (rolling back the completion). It’s utterly useless. To be clear, this is not the developer’s fault—iCloud sync is deplorable on every app where it’s used, including Apple’s own apps. But the developer should consider using something else. It’s a shame, because the underlying simple idea behind this app is good. If you’re going to use it, stick to just one device.

And example of this is, let’s say you have “brush your teeth” as a Streak and you want it to require 2 completions (brushing in the morning and in the evening). Well, if you complete just one of those, it doesn’t count for anything and will not show up in the overall graph. Let’s say you went awhile only brushing your teeth in the morning, well, that’s as good as not doing it at all because it doesn’t “track” partial completions.

There’s got to be a way to integrate this into the app, it’s a good way to visualize when you are doing well vs. doing ok vs. doing poorly.

Otherwise, the app is easy on the eyes, but the widgets are pretty ugly, I don’t know how to tackle that one hah!

author: Kjev

title: Simple, does it's one thing well.
body: This app adds a game like experience to managing habits. It encourages establishment or breaking of habits by simply recording you consistently. You tend to keep at it so as to not break a streak. It does Apple Watch too.
author: jhsis

title: Adding fun to ordinary to-dos
body: I like numbers and patterns. Streaks has both. I enjoy having a record of every time I've hit my walking goal, or remembered to floss, or [insert any other mundane task]. I want more integrations and a few quality of life fixes, and data exports. But Over all, very cool app with lots of promise.
author: incredimike

title: Pretty cool
body: I agree that less is more - having too many options had made me loose interest in other habit apps.. The more I use this the more I like it. Great design too!
